queue.title: Momentum USA 扩大了制动摩擦和转子目录
queue.text:
Momentum USA has added 12 part numbers to its brake friction and rotor catalog. The additions expand coverage to more than 5.3 million vehicles in operation across North America. The release adds coverage for commercial fleets, high-volume vehicles, electric vehicles and European imports.


Momentum USA Adds Late-Model Coverage

The expansion focuses on high-volume, late-model applications and emerging electric vehicle platforms. It also includes heavy-duty fleet vehicles and European imports. Momentum USA expanded coverage for the 2020-2026 Ford Police Interceptor Utility and Explorer. The AmeriBRAKES MAX DUTY rear pad set, RAM2231, covers these applications.

Popular Crossovers, SUVs and Minivans

The release expands coverage across several Hyundai, Kia and Honda models. Applications include the Hyundai Palisade, Santa Fe and Santa Cruz. Kia applications include the Sorento and Carnival with PTC2381. The release also covers the Honda HR-V and Honda Clarity with PRC2116 and CE2116.

[IMG:1]

Momentum USA added front ceramic pad options for the 2024-2027 Cadillac LYRIQ and Chevrolet Blazer EV. The PRC2521 pad covers these GM electric vehicle platforms.

The company added seven coated and R90 Euro rotor SKUs for Mercedes-Benz, Land Rover and Volvo applications. Coverage includes Mercedes-Benz S-Class, SLK and C-Class models. It also includes the Land Rover Defender and Range Rover Sport with 537200. The Volvo XC60 receives additional coverage with 521480.
